entries.4349ca1df55566e5: Companies working to improve employee engagement
entries.48b4cae28296f10e: A SaaS-type platform that supports corporate activities by improving companies' engagement. Through three steps (visualizing the current state of the organization through engagement surveys, support from a dedicated customer success representative in planning and designing internal systems, and a cloud tool for operating internal systems), it provides one-stop support for improving engagement. As of the end of December 2025, the number of client companies was 1,344. No separate amounts are disclosed.
entries.66ef38280de14ada: Businesses and creators that operate online communities (online salons)
entries.746bcb88df1bff52: A company that provides "TUNAG," a platform for increasing employee engagement, and "FANTS," an online community platform.
entries.96a8b327517f2d90: A single-segment business providing services that enhance engagement (mutual trust between the company and employees, and among employees). It operates the employee engagement business “TUNAG,” the community engagement business “FANTS,” and the cloud security service “Watchy.” Segment information is omitted because this business is the main business and other business segments are of little significance, and information by product and service is also omitted because external customer revenue from a single product and service category exceeds 90% of revenue. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,817 million.
entries.b123d09db1ff35c8: Companies that manage company computers and implement measures against information leaks
entries.f1bfcccc44e5c4ab: A cloud security service provided since February 2023. By managing and monitoring company computers, it supports IT asset management, measures against information leaks, labor management and similar functions. No separate amounts are disclosed.
entries.f932751b643f7884: A platform that provides, in one place, the functions needed to open an online community (online salon), such as membership registration and cancellation, billing and post management. Operated by the consolidated subsidiary Stadium Co., Ltd., it is used by communities across a wide range of categories, including professional sports teams, artists, talents, leisure facilities and schools. As of the end of December 2025, the number of communities operated was 566. No separate amounts are disclosed.
